INSERT INTO coordination_accounts
            (run_id, user_id, cohort, suspicion, factor, age, origin, client, sync, shape, burst)
        SELECT $1, t.*
        FROM UNNEST($2::bigint[], $3::int[], $4::int[], $5::int[], $6::int[], $7::int[],
                    $8::int[], $9::int[], $10::int[], $11::int[]) AS t
